color.note: One theme. The code's dark and light themes are identical and the app pins dark. Palette first (Theme.swift order), then the Mac-only surfaces, then the semantic roles of Theme as aliases, then one-off literals from views.

groups.name: iPhone and iPad
groups.note: Theme.typography. Sizes are iPhone points. On a tablet (shortest screen side 600 pt or more) every size and line height is multiplied by 1.3 and rounded to 0.1. Arabic text uses the system Arabic font (the brand fonts have no Arabic glyphs).

tokens.name: gradient-radialOrange
tokens.usage: Theme.gradients.radialOrange [lightYellow, darkYellow]: PremiumMark (linear, top-leading to bottom-trailing); orange radio and radialOrange card border use the SVG radial transform.

tokens.name: gradient-controlGreen
tokens.usage: SVGRadialGradient.control(Theme.gradients.green): fill of the green RadialGradientButton. Exact: the SVG transform translate(103.5, -2.68) rotate(90) scale(115.017, 474.806) is an axis-aligned ellipse in absolute points (474.806 wide, 115.017 tall, centre 103.5 / -2.68 from the top-left corner), so CSS can match it. Contrast: white label 2.37:1 at the label centre (1.73:1 at the lightest point), below 4.5:1. Kept exact; fix proposed in README Contrast.

tokens.name: gradient-controlNeutral
tokens.usage: SVGRadialGradient.control(Theme.gradients.neutralGray): fill of the neutral RadialGradientButton. Same geometry as gradient-controlGreen.

tokens.name: gradient-controlOrange
tokens.usage: SVGRadialGradient.control(Theme.gradients.radialOrange): 1 pt border of a selected GradientBorderCard (variant radialOrange, the chosen paywall plan). Same geometry as gradient-controlGreen.

tokens.name: gradient-controlTagBlue
tokens.usage: SVGRadialGradient.control(Theme.gradients.tagBlue) in UI/PremiumScreen.swift (PremiumCardTag): fill of the plan badge on a PremiumCard's top edge. Same absolute-point geometry as gradient-controlGreen; it does not scale with the badge. Contrast: white label 2.77:1, below 4.5:1. Kept exact; fix proposed in README Contrast.

tokens.name: gradient-green
tokens.usage: Theme.gradients.green [lightGreen, darkGreen] as a linear pair. The green RadialGradientButton uses gradient-controlGreen (exact). The green radio uses SVGRadialGradient.radio (stops 0.22892 / 0.633438, translate(10.8889, 5.25) rotate(82.614) scale(28.2343, 33.714)); CSS has no equal for that rotated ellipse, so the RadioButton preview draws it as an SVG radialGradient with the same transform.

tokens.name: gradient-tagBlue
tokens.usage: Theme.gradients.tagBlue [lightBlue, darkBlue]: PremiumCardTag (SVG radial in the app).
